definition.title: Repurpose an article for social
definition.description: Draft two X posts and two LinkedIn posts from a project article or supplied text, with exact source excerpts for review. Nothing is posted or scheduled.

human_review.summary: Check each social draft against its article before posting it yourself.

article_path.title: Article file
article_path.description: A relative project-file path. If omitted, a single matching article is used automatically.

article_text.title: Article text
article_text.description: Optional text to use when no article file is available or several files match.
